alerts.title: Main Road Status
alerts.description: The main park road from mile post 3 to Rainbow Point is currently closed due to winter weather conditions. It will remain closed until further notice.

alerts.title: Trail Closure Due to Recent Weather
alerts.description: The Bryce Connector Trail (Bryce Point to Peekaboo Loop Trail) is closed until further notice. Other park trails are open, but hikers are urged to use caution. Freezing temperatures overnight can make rockfall more likely during the day.

alerts.title: Dump Station Closed for Season
alerts.description: The dump station has closed due to early freezing temperatures. Please make other arrangements. Drinking fountains are also in the process of being winterized for the same reason. Please plan appropriately.

alerts.title: Current Fire Restrictions
alerts.description: Fires are only allowed in established fire pits.
